text_block_list.name: School Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about this?! You're really
willing to
try... the cursed ice cream?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so this notorious new flavor is...
grilled
mutton, eh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They say the moment you taste it, the
stench and
saltiness spread throughout
your whole mouth!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But it's not the taste you wanna watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who gives in to their curiosity
and tries
this stuff ends up—for whatever
reason—suffering
some sort of
mysterious misfortune that very
same
day!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Making basic mistakes on quizzes,
forgetting
their shoes...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Didn't one person even get her tail burnt
in a
hairdryer accident?

text_block_list.name: School Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, she did. Which is why the ice
cream's
rumored to be cursed. I haven't
been able to sell
a single cone since
then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please lay your worries to rest. I'll be the
one to
break the curse!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Once people know this ice cream is safe,
I'm sure
they'll be jumping at the chance
to buy it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Whaddya think you're looking at?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've got it. After hearing our plight,
your
daring heart is beating for a
challenge, is it?!

text_block_list.name: School Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're going to try it too?! Thank
you so
much!

Before I even have a chance to process
what's
happening, the employee brings
each of us an ice
cream.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that's an... interesting color. What
wouldja
call it? Mulberry?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This feels... deeply unnerving.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You sure about this, Satono? My gut's
telling me
we're teetering on a knife's
edge here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You can always take a step back to
where it's
safe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No! I can't back down now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You can never truly know the outcome
of an
action until you take it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Action is what guides us to outcomes!
And intent
determines our actions!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha! That's what I'm talkin'
about! I like
your pluck!

Realizing that I've missed my chance to
jump off
this sinking ship, I steel myself
and join Satono
Diamond and the others
in eating the ice cream.

Just as the rumors said, the truly
indescribable
flavor spreads throughout
my mouth...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Th-there! All finished! Now I suppose we
must
wait and see if anything bad
happens...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the curse to come to us,
huh? Heh...
That sounds pretty fun,
actually.
choice_data_list: なるべく大人しくしていよう……
不幸が起こるか、確かめに行こう！

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone! Let's hold on tight
and wait
it out!

text_block_list.name: Sketchy Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, finally made it in! Now, which
student
should I interview first? Gonna
hit 'em with all my
super hard-hitting
questions!

text_block_list.name: Sketchy Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Looks like I've found the perfect
targets.
Excuse meee...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! So you've shown yourself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y'know, I was gettin' real tired of waiting around!

text_block_list.name: Sketchy Reporter
text_block_list.text: Gyah! S-somebody help me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who was that just now?

And so, we successfully break the curse
without
encountering any disasters.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Egads! You mean we should go on the
offensive?
Sounds splendid! Onward,
comrades!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So we're all going to march around until

something happens, then? Challenge
accepted!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's march like we mean it! Last
one to
France is a rotten egg!

And so I set off strutting around the
school with
Satono Diamond and the
others...

As we march on fearlessly, no misfortune
befalls
us!
Word of our bravery spreads, and...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Can I get that cursed flavor?

Ah! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Looks like things are really
picking up
now! ♪

With the stigma gone, the ice cream's
distinct and
somewhat addictive taste
helps it to sell quickly.
However...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What?! It still hasn't sold out?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How could this be? We dispelled the
curse rumors
and everything!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: ……『ジンギスカン味』だからでは？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh.
